These two generated images are compared to delineate the boundary line between them. Based on the identified boundary line, the occluded mask image is restored by utilizing numpy to fill obscured areas with a value of 1. Then, the restored occluded mask image is overlaid onto the RGB image. This combined image, depicted in (C), serves as an input for the HPE model. The HPE model then estimates 17 key points. However, if certain key points are not detected, these undetected key points are typically located near the corners of the image.
